meta.name: The Ghost Detective
meta.description: Da Il, a ghost detective, meets a mysterious woman named Woo Hye and gets drawn into a strange case.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Da Il and Sang Seob run a detective agency that is on the verge of going out of business. One day, a client comes to them, asking to find a missing child. However, the more Da Il digs, the stranger the case becomes.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Da Il suspects that the teacher at the academy is the person who abducted the three kids. While working on the case at the office, an aspiring detective pays him a visit. However, after a strange turn of events, Da Il meets a tragic end.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Yeo Wool thinks it's strange that Da Il disappeared from the crime scene, leav-ing the kids behind. The police investigating the case also finds the case strange. Meanwhile, Yeo Wool keeps looking for Da Il and worries that some-thing might have happened to him.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Da Il comes to Yeo Wool's house and asks her about what she knows. From Yeo Wool's story, he learns more about the mysterious woman he saw. Togeth-er, they start looking for clues.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The manager of the restaurant Yi Rang used to work at jumps off a building af-ter saying something ominous. Da Il can't help but feel sympathy toward Yeo Woo because he knows very well how she must be feeling right now. The woman in red is coming for them.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Da Il gets a feeling that Yi Rang's hearing aid will provide a clue to find out more about the woman in red. With Yeo Wool, he follows the lead. The woman in red's next target is the principal of the pre-school.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: In order to pursue the woman in red, Da Il realizes that he'll need help from Sang Seob. Yeo Wool takes Sang Seob to the location where Da Il was buried, but Sang Seob doesn't believe anything she says.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: When Sang Seob finds Da Il's identification tag, he accepts the fact that Da Il is dead. Da Il and Sang Seob work together to find leads with the help of Yeo Wool. Meanwhile, the woman in red gives Da Il a warning.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The woman in red warns Da Il about how she'll kill everyone that loves him. Sang Seob becomes the next target. While working on the case, Sang Seob gets attacked. Da Il tries to find a way to help Sang Seob.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: It turns out that the police officer Sang Seob was looking for killed himself 20 years ago. Da Il senses that Sang Seob is in imminent danger. They must find him before it's too late.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: The “A Few Good Men” Team rushes to the hospital where Sunwoo Hye is supposedly hospitalized. However, they quickly discover that Sunwoo Hye had already made a run for it. Through the help of Sunwoo Hye’s nurse, Jeon Deok Joong, Da Il and Yeo Wool chase after Sunwoo Hye from all possible directions.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Yeo Wool and Da Il go and meet a shaman hoping to gain information on how to kill a fetch. Knowing that they would get into trouble, Chae Won goes to help them and ends up saving them in the nick of time. Later, the group decides whether or not what the shaman had told them is worth doing.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Da Il learns how to touch objects and stabs Hye with a knife before Yeo Wool does. Hye becomes a living person and runs away from the hospital after killing four medical staff, and Yeo Wool thinks it all happened because of her as she was not the one who stabbed Hye.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Jeong Dae asks Yeo Wool to tell the truth as her fingerprint was found at the crime scene. Yeo Wool tries to tell Jeong Dae that she was the one who stabbed Hye, but Da Il tells her to deny it. Meanwhile, Da Il records a video of a man who saw Hye at the hospital and sends it to Eun Chong.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The team must take a different approach now that Sunwoo Hye has a body. With a body that can move, her scope of action has broadened. Meanwhile, Da Il goes to the interrogation room where Deok Joong is being held.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Sunwoo Hye is trying to kill hundreds of lives by controlling Gyeol. The team must find out why and how she is intending on killing those people. Da Il re-members something about Sunwoo Hye and tries to connect the dots.
